# Overbay.app

> Small, offline-first apps I build for Android, desktop, and home servers. No ads, no tracking, no monthly subscriptions.

- Website: https://overbay.app/
- Developer: Neal Overbay
- Full reference: https://overbay.app/llms-full.txt
- Contact: privacy@overbay.app

## Applications

- [Luma Reader](https://overbay.app/lumareader/): Offline Android EPUB and PDF reader (`app.overbay.lumareader`) with custom themes, foldable two-page spreads, Android read-aloud, and optional private `drive.appdata` Google Drive sync. Free up to 5 books; $4.99 once for unlimited.
- [AllNotes](https://overbay.app/allnotes/): Note app (`app.overbay.allnotes`) with OneNote-style Notebooks, Section Groups, and Tabs paired with clean, normal pages instead of a 2D canvas. Works offline on Android; Windows and optional self-hosted sync coming soon.
- [Orbit Money](https://overbay.app/orbitmoney/): Open-source personal and household budgeting app (`app.overbay.orbit`) for Android, Web App, and Docker (`ghcr.io/waspo98/orbit-money`) with exact-cent math, fingerprint lock, optional Google Drive backup, Rocket Money CSV import, and optional SimpleFIN bank sync.
- [Twitter — Overbay Labs](https://overbay.app/labs/twitter/): Open-source MIT sideload-only Android app for Twitter (`app.overbay.twitter`) with no ads, no Grok, no Premium upsells, classic blue look, unwrapped tracking links, keyword mute filters, and full-res photo/video downloads. Not affiliated with X Corp.

## Privacy & Compliance

- [Privacy Hub](https://overbay.app/privacy/): Site privacy policy and per-app index.
- [Luma Reader Privacy Policy](https://overbay.app/privacy/lumareader/): Google Play disclosures including `drive.appdata` Limited Use compliance and Play Billing.
- [AllNotes Privacy Policy](https://overbay.app/privacy/allnotes/): Google Play disclosures for local storage and optional self-hosted sync.
- [Orbit Money Privacy Policy](https://overbay.app/privacy/orbitmoney/): Google Play disclosures for local/Docker modes, Drive backups, biometric lock, and SimpleFIN.
- [Data & Account Deletion](https://overbay.app/data-deletion/): Instructions for wiping local data, revoking Google access, and removing self-hosted data.
- [Terms of Service](https://overbay.app/terms/): Licensing, Play Billing, budgeting disclaimer, and open-source terms.
